title: AI Solutions for Smart Mushroom Farming Challenge
description: Develop an innovative AI-powered solution that improves mushroom cultivation through automation, environmental monitoring, disease detection, predictive analytics, or resource optimization. Participants are encouraged to leverage artificial intelligence, IoT devices, computer vision, or data analytics to address real-world challenges faced by mushroom farmers. The most impactful solutions will be showcased at the BRIDGE-AI Innovation Forum and may be considered for pilot implementation within the Smart Mushroom Project.
